entries.title: Hebrews 7:1
segments: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of the Most High God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:2
segments: To him Abraham also gave a tenth of all. [He was] first by interpretation king of righteousness, and after that also king of Salem, which is king of peace,

entries.title: Hebrews 7:3
segments: without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, [he] remains a priest continually.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:4
segments: Now consider how great this man [was], to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:5
segments: And truly they [who are] of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priest, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the Law, that is, from their brothers, though they come out of the loins of Abraham.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:6
segments: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:7
segments: And without all contradiction the lesser is blessed by the better.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:8
segments: And here men who die receive tithes; but there he [receives them], of whom it is witnessed that he lives.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:9
segments: And if I may say so, Levi, also, who receives tithes, paid tithes in Abraham.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:10
segments: For he was still in the loins of his father when Melchizedek met him.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:11
segments: Therefore if perfection were by the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the Law), what further need [was there] that another priest should rise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

entries.title: Hebrews 7:12
segments: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made in the law also.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:13
segments: For He of whom these things are spoken belongs to another tribe, from which no man gave attendance at the altar.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:14
segments: For [it is] evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah, of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:15
segments: And it is still far more evident, since there arises a different priest after the likeness of Melchizedek,

entries.title: Hebrews 7:16
segments: who is made, not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an endless life.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:17
segments: For He testifies, "You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek."

entries.title: Hebrews 7:18
segments: For [truly there] is a putting away of the commandment which went before, because of the weakness and unprofitableness of it.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:19
segments: For the Law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope [did], by which we draw near to God.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:20
segments: And inasmuch as [He was not made priest] without an oath

entries.title: Hebrews 7:21
segments: (for those priests were made without an oath, but this one was made with an oath by Him who said to Him, "The Lord swore and will not repent, You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek,")

entries.title: Hebrews 7:22
segments: by so much was Jesus made a surety of a better covenant.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:23
segments: And they truly were many priests, because they were not allowed to continue because of death;

entries.title: Hebrews 7:24
segments: but He, because He continues forever, has an unchangeable priesthood.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:25
segments: Therefore He is able also to save to the uttermost those who come unto God by Him, [since He] ever lives to make intercession for them.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:26
segments: For such a high priest became us, [who is] holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners and made higher than the heavens,

entries.title: Hebrews 7:27
segments: who does not need, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice daily, first for his own [sins] and then for the people's sins. For He did this once for all, when He offered up Himself.

entries.title: Hebrews 7:28
segments: For the Law appoints men high priests who have infirmity, but the word of the swearing of an oath, after the Law, [has consecrated] the Son forever, having been perfected.
